phases.goal: Finish all five chapters and every named story mission. This phase earns the 12 story trophies and the final-mission Gold.
phases.tips: Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: there is no mission replay, and a save per chapter is the safety net PowerPyx and GTABase both recommend. In Chapter 1, do the optional meditation with Lucia at Jason's house the morning after the mission Down to Earth - follow her to the balcony and accept. It is the only moment in the game that can be missed, and it may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude. While you play, scan new vehicles and animals when you see them; PowerPyx puts that in this phase and it feeds the discovery trophies later.
phases.title: Play the story - and protect the one missable

phases.goal: Finish the side-character mission strands and 8 stranger strands in total. This phase earns the five side-character finals, the hunting trophy and the Silver for stranger strands.
phases.tips: Follow the stranger icons on the map whenever you pass one, and finish each strand to its end - Strangers & Freaks needs 8 whole strands, not 8 single missions. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a final mission with its own trophy, and Bret's strand ends with a hunt for a unique animal. None of these can be missed: PowerPyx confirms side strands can be finished in free roam after the story.
phases.title: Side stories: strangers and fixers

phases.goal: Cover the map: all 52 areas, the 18 meditation spots, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK It locations, 3 card sets, 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations, plus the small flavour moments.
phases.tips: Do this as one big road trip and let the counters overlap: every new district earns area progress, a WAiNK It, and often a new vehicle, all at once. Meditate at every spot with both characters where you can - each spot counts twice that way. Buy a garage whenever you can afford one, and register every new vehicle to the Scooter Bros app as you find it. The beachfront cocktail, the showroom smash and the bowling alley are small stops on the same trip.
phases.title: See all of Leonida: collectibles and discovery

phases.goal: Clear the activity trophies: 250 stunts, 42 gold shooting-range medals, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, 50 challenges, the partner feats, the robberies and the money trophies.
phases.tips: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges first - it is the longest single grind in this phase. Then work the races: 14 drone-race locations and 20 different races. The partner trophies need both characters together, so do Hot Together and Retail Therapy back to back. Rob the 5 bank vaults, one armored truck and one illegal operation per gang, and launder your Marked Bills after every score toward the $250,000 target. Spend as you go toward $100,000 in shops. The five vague trophies - Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin - are not yet confirmed in-game; play normally and let them pop, and check the guide notes for the latest confirmed method.
phases.title: Activities, races and robberies

phases.goal: Open the 100% checklist after the credits and finish whatever is left, then watch the Platinum pop.
phases.tips: The checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and only after the story. It covers story missions, optional tasks, robberies, fencing totals, collectibles, activities and scanning. PowerPyx and GTABase agree nothing on it is permanently missable, so this phase is a checklist, not a second playthrough. When the checklist hits 100%, A Long Road pops, and with every other trophy done, Vice Got a Price! follows immediately.
phases.title: 100% and the Platinum

summary: One playthrough, five phases, about 200 hours by PowerPyx's estimate. There are no online trophies and, by every launch-era guide, only one trophy that can possibly be missed. The order below follows PowerPyx's two-step roadmap, expanded into five phases so the tracker can show what to do when.
title: Road to the Platinum: Vice Got a Price!
